milestones.label: Moore et al., 1989
milestones.title: THE INFLUENCE OF WATER TABLE LEVELS ON METHANE AND CARBON DIOXIDE EMISSIONS FROM PEATLAND SOILS
milestones.note: This laboratory study measured carbon dioxide and methane emissions from columns packed with surface soils from a fen, a bog, and a swamp under varying water table levels

milestones.label: Gorham et al., 1991
milestones.title: Northern Peatlands: Role in the Carbon Cycle and Probable Responses to Climatic Warming
milestones.note: This review paper synthesizes estimates of carbon stocks, accumulation rates, and greenhouse gas fluxes (CO2 and CH4) for northern boreal and subarctic peatlands

milestones.label: Lai et al., 2009
milestones.title: Methane Dynamics in Northern Peatlands: A Review
milestones.note: This paper is a review of methane dynamics in northern peatlands

milestones.label: Bridgham et al., 2012
milestones.title: Methane emissions from wetlands: biogeochemical, microbial, and modeling perspectives from local to global scales
milestones.note: This review paper provides a comprehensive synthesis of wetland methane emissions, integrating biogeochemical, molecular microbial, and modeling perspectives from local to global scales

milestones.label: Olefeldt et al., 2012
milestones.title: Environmental and physical controls on northern terrestrial methane emissions across permafrost zones
milestones.note: This study compiled a database of growing-season methane emissions across northern permafrost zones to assess environmental and physical controls

milestones.label: Pangala et al., 2012
milestones.title: Trees are major conduits for methane egress from tropical forested wetlands
milestones.note: This study quantified in situ methane emissions from tree stems, peatland surfaces, and pneumatophores in a tropical forested peatland in Southeast Asia using static chambers

milestones.label: Turetsky et al., 2014
milestones.title: A synthesis of methane emissions from 71 northern, temperate, and subtropical wetlands
milestones.note: Wetland methane emissions are driven by soil temperature and water table in swamps and bogs, but these relationships are strongly modified by wetland type, region, and disturbance history.

milestones.label: Loisel et al., 2014
milestones.title: A database and synthesis of northern peatland soil properties and Holocene carbon and nitrogen accumulation
milestones.note: This study presents a comprehensive global database of northern peatland soil properties, including 268 peat cores from 215 sites north of 45°N to estimate Holocene carbon and nitrogen accumulation rates

milestones.label: Etminan et al., 2016
milestones.title: Radiative forcing of carbon dioxide, methane, and nitrous oxide: A significant revision of the methane radiative forcing
milestones.note: This study recalculates the radiative forcing of carbon dioxide, methane, and nitrous oxide using updated models, finding that methane's radiative forcing is about 25% higher due to shortwave forcing inclusion

milestones.label: Angle et al., 2017
milestones.title: Methanogenesis in oxygenated soils is a substantial fraction of wetland methane emissions
milestones.note: This study challenges the paradigm that methanogenesis only occurs in anoxic habitats by demonstrating substantial methane production in well-oxygenated wetland soils

milestones.label: Saunois et al., 2019
milestones.title: The Global Methane Budget 2000-2017
milestones.note: This study synthesizes global methane budgets for 2000-2017 using a combination of top-down atmospheric inversions and bottom-up models, highlighting that anthropogenic sources account for about 60% of total emissions

milestones.label: Knox et al., 2019
milestones.title: FLUXNET-CH4 Synthesis Activity: Objectives, Observations, and Future Directions
milestones.note: This paper introduces the FLUXNET-CH4 synthesis activity, which coordinates ecosystem-scale methane flux measurements across 60 global sites using eddy covariance techniques
